What We Do

Proofing, removal & protection services

From monthly pest plans to full attic restoration, one crew handles the whole job — extermination, cleanup, and the structural work that keeps animals and pests out for good.

Rodent & Wildlife Control

Humane removal and exclusion for the animals that get into Georgia attics, roofs and crawlspaces.

  • Norway rats & roof rats
  • Gray & flying squirrels
  • Raccoons, possums & bats
  • Mice, armadillos & chipmunks

Attic Insulation & Restoration

We remove contaminated insulation, sanitize the space, and blow in fresh insulation so your attic is clean and efficient again.

  • Insulation removal & blow-in installs
  • Disinfecting & deodorizing
  • Rodent fecal cleanouts
  • Attic gables & vents sealed

Crawlspace & Drainage

Moisture is what invites pests and mold in the first place. We dry out, seal and drain the spaces under your home.

  • Moisture barriers & standing water
  • French drainage systems
  • Sump pump installs
  • Foundation vents & crawlspace doors

Gutter Cleaning & Guards

Clean gutters and the right guards keep water — and the pests that follow it — away from your roofline.

  • Gutter & downspout cleaning
  • Leaf guard & gutter protectors
  • Gutter repairs
  • Tree limb removal

Plus full pest control plans — monthly, bi-monthly or quarterly service for cockroaches, ants, bedbugs, fleas & ticks, mosquitoes, hornets & wasps, silverfish, earwigs and more.

About Us

Professional work. Fair prices. No shortcuts.

Veterans Home Proof was established in 2014 with a simple mission: provide professional, quality services at fair and affordable prices while protecting homeowners and their properties.

Customer service and honesty are the most important aspects of our business, and your satisfaction is our number one priority. We pay attention to detail on every job — pest control, cleanup, and the structural enhancements that keep the problem from coming back.
